## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 11, also known as the *Garupāvuraṇa-sikkhāpada*, is a monastic training rule from the Vinaya Piṭaka governing the conduct of Buddhist nuns (*bhikkhunī*s). The rule addresses the requisition or exchange of an excessively expensive, heavy outer cloak or robe (*garupāvuraṇa*), prescribing that a nun who asks for such a garment must forfeit it and confess the infraction. An English translation of the rule and its accompanying commentary is available by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
